description.value: Fred Tibbs Condo Hotel is a purpose-built strata hotel on Main Street in central Tofino, operating as tourist accommodation since 1997, where each suite is individually owned but collectively managed. The two-storey building offers ocean-view studio and loft suites within easy walking distance of cafes, restaurants, shops, and the waterfront. A full-service café and bakery operates on the ground floor, and the building includes a kayak and canoe launch.
